column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹30.00 lakh
was the net effect of
increase of ₹37.50 lakh
and decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹7.50 lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
motor car office and
medical reimbursement.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2025).
